description: Fill a saved PodPDF template with data and render it to PDF. Template IDs are shown in the dashboard (Templates → Use via API). Docs: https://apidocs.podpdf.com/api-reference/templates

data.description: Values for the template's fields; nested objects and arrays of objects for list fields. A dotted key such as "customer.name" is also accepted.

save_path.description: Optional local file path to save the PDF to, e.g. "./invoice.pdf". The download link is returned either way.

template_id.description: Template ID from the PodPDF dashboard

name: render_template
title: Render Template
